scope: S3 case C5 (loss of offsite power with the Grid handoff). Lines frozen before any C5 run on the gated harness (RP1, P1); revision 2, before any run, derives O3's bound from the field controller's timing including its decision frame (lead) and names its cause (S3-D48); probe values from the existing full-unit LOOP previews (C5X, ICFIELD), each receipt named; previews are not evidence

commonRules.from: ld01-s3-cases-c1c3 revision 3.7 (RP1-pin-s3-c1c3-r3.7): common rules A to L of the S3 draft; the values the C5 harness reads are copied here verbatim
commonRules.eventClasses: S3-D4 rule (storage-rate-only held input S; else R)
commonRules.derivedTolerance: S3-D16: tightest credited budget the coordinate determines x |sensitivity|

kineticsDomain.ruleI: A4 (owner-approved, R5-A): a case runs to its declared end, or until D3 (a) ends it, labelled
kineticsDomain.floor: B1 (owner-approved, R5-B): HOT-SOURCE-1's pressure floor 8 MPa (reference-operating-source) with a per-core-region phase-absence check; a failing region ends the run, labelled

phaseBirth.rule: G1 (owner-approved, R5-G): vapour is born in a liquid-only cell at liquid superheat creditedMax_K, not at exact saturation
phaseBirth.disclosure: a declared nucleation-delay model, not a prediction of nucleation

frameAlignment.rule: every case starts on a frame instant; event times are stated relative to the case start, with their offset from the frame grid

accuracyExtension.basis: S3-D16: credited budgets for the electrical outputs

derivedStatorClass.basis: S3-D23: the 10 A protection-current budget is the tighter one

openItems.F1: no Linux 6-8-core measurement host now (R5-F1): CPU results are provisional and S3 cannot formally exit

C5.initialCondition: the S3 settled state of section 1.3 re-settled with ELEC's slice carrying owner D2's carrier (S3-D19: the snapshot field carrier_rad_s): PZR pressure control in AUTO, the generator connected and exporting through D1 + D2's exchange, the S3 tolerance classes
C5.durationFrom: the case start, as C3's duration_s: the offsite loss at 10.37 s leaves 109.63 s of coastdown
C5.lineTimesFrom: the offsite loss (t0 = 10.37 s after the case start)

malfunction.what: S3-D10's loss of offsite power at t0: the stator separates through the generator page's zero-duration passive arc-quench limit, the unit and reserve sources are dead, and there is no house-load island
malfunction.declaredBy: the Grid stand-in's exchange: the boundary of the interval starting at t0 is a dead bus (D1: a known discontinuity splits an interval exactly)
malfunction.class: R (S3-D4: a change to an algebraic constraint)

C5.feed: S3-D12: the recorded feed (F3 (a)) is gated to zero by the feed pumps' supply state, applied in the offsite loss's instant; a limit disclosed until S5's feed train

fieldSupplyLossProtection.what: the generator page's ACT.B field controller (field-supply loss and control-power failure): the field converter on AC.B (ld01-ac-distribution fieldConverterBus) loses its delivered supply at t0; while the generator is reported connected, connection is pending or its evidence is unavailable, the controller withdraws CLOSE and requests generator OPEN plus a turbine trip at its next powered decision, with no qualification delay
fieldSupplyLossProtection.replaces: the r3 draft's declared turbine-trip input at t0 + 0.2 s (S3-D43 corrected: the generator page selects the function; ICFIELD implements it), so C5 has no declared trip input

exchange.law: owner D1 + D2 (R5-D) against the test-only Grid stand-in that implements ELEC's ADR contract (R5-F4: no live registration)
exchange.gridWindow: S3-D42 (owner-confirmed, request 6 K): the 20 ms grid-event window applies to grid-connected units only; after t0 the unit's bus is dead, so it exchanges at the 1 s quiet cadence with zero-energy receipts. Before t0 the stand-in holds a stiff 50 Hz carrier (frequency rate 0, SW-1), so every boundary agrees with the held prediction
exchange.exchangeRefinement: not applicable to C5: a dead bus has no grid-event window (S3-D42); the 10 ms against 20 ms pair belongs to the frequency-event probe (D2)
exchange.receipts: the slice's IDAS quadratures per interval (generator export, unit and reserve auxiliary draws), each interval's receipts summing bitwise to the cumulative quadrature
exchange.requestE: moot for C5 under S3-D42: no grid-event window exists after t0, so only the plant's own event window counts against 0.5

windows.basis: 0015 E2's pump-loss window; owner request 6 K EW-1: 20 ms stays the default event-window cap (an uncapped window only where its credited outputs match the E3 2.5 ms reference and pass the cap-cycle check)

ends.rule: the run ends at the first of the following, labelled; any other stop is a failure
ends.ruleI: rule I at every accepted step: A4's D3 (a) exit, B1's 8 MPa floor and B1's per-core-region phase-absence check as the wiki states it (lead S2-D42): vapour present in a core region's coolant ends the run, labelled
ends.naturalCirculation: no natural-circulation credit (rule J): the coastdown is reported, nothing is claimed past it

O1.action: at t0, in the offsite loss's one class-R instant: the Grid receipts the signed export step (the last interval ending at t0 carries the export, the interval starting at t0 and every later one zero export energy); every RCP's drive support and both feed pumps' supply are lost (no RCP supported after t0); the four RCPs coast down; the recorded feed is gated to zero (S3-D12)
O1.probe: export 1,010.3 MW before t0, 0 J after; 0 RCPs supported after t0 (ICFIELD preview c5-a120-1.json (app 92c2db474, sha256 9d784787ea049911a1ae37a532c66da54c60560a4febb0f6b3fc5641fcbb3a0f))

O2.action: the six motor contactors (LD01.P.A1, LD01.P.A2, LD01.P.B1, LD01.P.B2, LD01.FW.P1, LD01.FW.P2) drop out on undervoltage, class O (no physics change), judged on the routing's own record times
O2.probe: routing records +1.000 s for all six (ICFIELD preview c5-a120-1.json (app 92c2db474, sha256 9d784787ea049911a1ae37a532c66da54c60560a4febb0f6b3fc5641fcbb3a0f))

O3.action: the field-supply-loss protection: the ACT.B field controller, on cause LD01.TG.GEN.FIELD.SUPPLY_LOSS (S3-D48), withdraws CLOSE and requests generator OPEN plus a turbine trip in one class-R instant at its decision; the generator breaker is open, and the turbine's STOP ramp ends, one breaker travel after that instant
O3.windowRule: the request in (0, reportSample_s + reportTransport_s + frame_s] after t0: the loss is taken at the controller's next 0.1 s report sample, delivered 0.1 s later, and the requests follow at its next powered decision, at most one 0.1 s I&C frame later (ld01-generator-field-protection: additionalQualification_s 0; frameAlignment.frame_s; lead, 15 Oct); a rule-set window derived before any gated run, its bounds inclusive at the frame driver's instant resolution
O3.breakerTravelRule: ld01-generator-switching breakerTravel_s: the breaker open and the STOP ramp end (as C2.O2, 0.3 s after the turbine trip) exactly one travel after the request, so within (0.3, 0.6] s after t0
O3.probe: request and turbine trip +0.13 s; GCB open and STOP ramp end +0.43 s (ICFIELD preview c5-a120-1.json (app 92c2db474, sha256 9d784787ea049911a1ae37a532c66da54c60560a4febb0f6b3fc5641fcbb3a0f))

O4.action: LD01.PROT.TG.TRIP accepted in each powered division (I1-I3) from the turbine-state report of O3's acquired turbine trip; LD01.TRIP.HOLD lost at the first accepted reactor-trip cause; a PRHR request with each division's cause; all 52 bodies seat after the release (S2's G9); rule A': every accepted cause has its predicate met on acquired evidence and every met predicate yields its cause
O4.windowRule: ld01-turbine-state-report: 0.1 s sampling, 0.1 s transport (C2.O1's window); a rule-set window, its bounds inclusive at the frame driver's instant resolution
O4.probe: TG.TRIP I1-I3 and holding lost +0.33 s (0.20 s after the trip); PRHR requests +0.33 s; 52 seats by +2.21 s (ICFIELD preview c5-a120-1.json (app 92c2db474, sha256 9d784787ea049911a1ae37a532c66da54c60560a4febb0f6b3fc5641fcbb3a0f))

O5.action: SG relief crack in both SGs (ld01-sg-relief crackPressure_Pa 6.8 MPa)
O5.marginRule: (20 s - the later SG's first crack after t0) / 20 s; below the duration fraction the line becomes may occur (A'')
O5.probe: SG.A +1.811 s, SG.B +1.814 s (ICFIELD preview c5-a120-1.json (app 92c2db474, sha256 9d784787ea049911a1ae37a532c66da54c60560a4febb0f6b3fc5641fcbb3a0f))

N2.action: PZR low level: the acquired PZR LT vote at or below lowLevel_m for lowQualification_s (ld01-pzr-level-protection: 3.00 m, 0.5 s); LD01.PROT.PZR.LOW_LEVEL is not implemented in S3 (S3-D21), so the section's recorded LT vote monitor is judged
N2.marginRule: (the lowest collapsed PZR level after t0 - 3.00 m) / (the collapsed level at t0 - 3.00 m); below the setpoint-distance fraction the line becomes may occur (A'')
N2.probe: collapsed level 5.943 m at t0, minimum 4.326 m at +71.6 s (P-6b, full-unit LOOP: ICFIELD preview c5-a120-1.json (app 92c2db474, sha256 9d784787ea049911a1ae37a532c66da54c60560a4febb0f6b3fc5641fcbb3a0f); C5X preview c5-campaign-1.json (app 9baab135f, sha256 a1b0381047edee9e0556f70538cc2b2ea7d7c32f2130f57326f5fe2727ba436f))

the end value below the value at t0, and no sample after t0 above it

the largest sample after t0 above the value at t0 and inside the event window, and the end value below the value at t0
the largest sample after t0 above the value at t0, and the end value below that largest sample
the largest sample after t0 above the value at t0, and the end value below that largest sample

directions.check: no feed supported from t0 to the end

directions.signal: the slice's terminal export and the interval receipts
directions.check: exactly zero export energy in every interval from t0
not executable against the test-only stand-in: a stiff 50 Hz bus that is dead from t0 (R5-F4); the frequency-event probe (D2) carries the Grid's response

gates.directions: rule B on the table above, each a signed check on frame samples with its magnitudes reported (rule C); no threshold beyond the sign (S3-D45's drafting rule)
gates.conservation: rule D: S2's identities and ledgers, plus heater and spray, relief discharge, turbine and shaft work, generator terminal energy, auxiliary motor energy and the Grid's signed watt-seconds; the interval receipts sum bitwise to the cumulative quadrature; rotor energy once
gates.refinement: rule E as S3GATES reads it (S3-D45): R1, a 2.5 ms-capped reference over the event window, and R2 (rtol x 0.01, every absolute tolerance x 0.1, derived classes included) to the end; credited outputs within the accuracy contract (E0); rule E' on Ieq (10 A) and terminal power (1 MW)
gates.smoothness: rule F with S3GATES's detector once the lead signs it (S3-D45); not judged before
gates.repeatability: rule H: an identical second run, bitwise on one host
gates.spectra: rule K: Z6's predicate at the event window's end state, from an external SPECTRUM receipt naming that state
gates.cost: rule G: the run at most s3UnitRecurringIncludingEvents; S2's additional budgets over the intervals rule I leaves: the event window and its recovery each at most s2WindowAndRecovery, and s2TripAverage from the holding loss to the end (C4's reading); the span before t0 reported; instructions retired converted at the quiet ratio, raw thread CPU alongside; provisional on macOS (R5-F1)
gates.residuals: S3-D45: every receipt reports the largest algebraic residual per row family (reported, not a gate)
